declared_scope: The v0.12 parent stack plus a single reversible sysctl: vm.watermark_scale_factor=200 (channel: memory). Autonomously proposed; one knob added, nothing removed.
hypothesis: Raising watermark_scale_factor (10->200) starts reclaim earlier, reducing direct-reclaim stalls under the memory-pressure probe. Expect steadier refault time; watch idle power / neutral elsewhere.
rollback_method: Restores the prior vm.watermark_scale_factor value captured at apply time, then delegates the rest of the revert to the v0.12 preset undo; harness reverts at run end.
